subject: 2026-10-07-first-digital-spac-agentic-commerce
text:
Brief says: "A stablecoin issuer going public specifically to build out wallets and payment rails for AI agents" (note)
Source says: "The Nasdaq listing is designed to help First Digital fund the expansion of Finance District, "ecosystem for the agentic economy," the company said" (https://www.pymnts.com/cryptocurrency/2026/first-digital-eyes-agentic-commerce-expansion-with-spac-listing/)
Suggested fix: "A stablecoin issuer listing on Nasdaq to help fund its ecosystem for the agentic economy, including a wallet AI agents already use, ..." ("specifically to build out wallets and payment rails" is narrower and stronger than the source.)
